decks.notes: The main strategy of this deck is to flood the board with low-cost creatures such as Faerie Miscreant and Faerie Seer, supported by counter spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce to control the opponent's plays. With additional card draw from Preordain, Of One Mind, and Ninja of the Deep Hours, the deck aims to maintain tempo and pressure the opponent with a consistent stream of threats. Moon-Circuit Hacker provides a late-game finisher and Bind the Monster offers additional removal options to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly building up a single creature with powerful auras to overwhelm the opponent. By using cheap aura spells like Rancor and Ethereal Armor, combined with hexproof creatures like Silhana Ledgewalker and Slippery Bogle, the deck aims to create an unstoppable threat. Cards like Ancestral Mask and Armadillo Cloak provide additional power and protection, while cards like Utopia Sprawl and Abundant Growth help to ramp up mana production. The deck's goal is to race ahead in damage and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This Aggro - Affinity deck utilizes artifact creatures and cards that benefit from having artifacts on the battlefield. By playing cheap artifacts and using cards like Galvanic Blast and Makeshift Munitions for direct damage, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly with large threats like Myr Enforcer and Gearseeker Serpent. The deck also includes cards like Nihil Spellbomb and Chainer's Edict for disruption and removal, allowing for a focused and aggressive strategy to take down opponents efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent through aggressive creatures like Vampire Sovereign and Inspiring Overseer. It also aims to control the board with removal spells like Chainer's Edict and Cast Down. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Ephemerate and Kor Skyfisher to provide value and card advantage. The inclusion of lifegain lands like Kabira Crossroads and efficient creatures like Thraben Inspector and Goliath Paladin help to ensure resilience and staying power in longer games.

The control strategy of this deck revolves around assembling the Urzatron - Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Mine, and Urza's Tower - to generate a large amount of mana. This enables the player to play powerful spells and utilize various card advantage engines like Mulldrifter and Mystical Teachings. The deck also includes interactive spells such as Ghostly Flicker and Mnemonic Wall to control the board and gain incremental advantages. Overall, the key idea is to establish a dominant position through mana advantage and card advantage to outvalue the opponent and eventually win the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to quickly generate advantage and deal damage to the opponent. By sacrificing artifacts like Ichor Wellspring and Nihil Spellbomb with cards like Makeshift Munitions and Deadly Dispute, the deck can control the board and threaten the opponent's life total. Cards like Galvanic Blast and Krark-Clan Shaman provide additional reach and removal options, while creatures like Myr Enforcer and Gearseeker Serpent can quickly close out the game. The mana base is optimized for casting artifacts efficiently and consistently.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of Orzhov creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Using cards like Kor Skyfisher, Vampire Sovereign, and Spirited Companion, along with removal spells like Cast Down and Chainer's Edict, the deck aims to control the board while dealing consistent damage. The deck also includes recursion with cards like Omen of the Dead and Ephemerate to maintain a strong presence on the battlefield. Overall, the Orzhov Aggro deck combines efficient creatures and removal to put pressure on the opponent and secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with cheap and efficient creatures, utilizing Ninjutsu with Ninja of the Deep Hours for card advantage. The inclusion of disruptive elements like Spellstutter Sprite and counterspells helps to control the game, while cards like Mutagenic Growth and Of One Mind help maintain tempo. The deck aims to consistently apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan, ultimately securing victory through a combination of aggression and control.

The deck focuses on establishing control through the use of Gates synergy, defensive creatures, and removal spells. By utilizing mana-efficient cards and card advantage, the strategy aims to outlast opponents and slowly grind them down while maintaining board presence. The Gates provide mana fixing and card draw options, while the creatures and removal spells offer protection and disruption against aggressive strategies. With a mix of defensive options and efficient threats, the deck aims to control the game until it can secure a victory.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, efficient white creatures. The deck aims to quickly establish a board presence with cards like Squadron Hawk and Militia Bugler, while also having control elements like Journey to Nowhere and Prismatic Strands to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The addition of lifegain lands like Kabira Crossroads and Radiant Fountain helps to maintain longevity in the aggro strategy. Overall, the deck seeks to apply pressure early on and maintain it throughout the game with a steady stream of threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures combined with powerful aura enchantments to quickly overwhelm opponents with damage. By using cards like Ethereal Armor, Rancor, and Ancestral Mask, the goal is to buff up creatures like Gladecover Scout and Slippery Bogle to create a fast and aggressive offense. Armadillo Cloak and Spirit Link provide additional defense and lifelink to keep the pressure on opponents. The deck also includes cards like Abundant Growth and Utopia Sprawl to ramp up mana and ensure consistent draws.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with fast and aggressive plays, using powerful burn spells like Fireblast, Chain Lightning, and Lightning Bolt to quickly reduce their life total. Monastery Swiftspear and Kessig Flamebreather provide additional damage sources, while cards like Wrenn's Resolve and Thermo-Alchemist help maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to end games quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize, utilizing low-cost, efficient creatures and burn spells to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is utilizing counterspells, removal, and card draw to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck includes powerful spells like Counterspell, Snuff Out, and Thought Scour to control the board while also utilizing card advantage with Deep Analysis and unexpected lifegain with Unexpected Fangs. The deck aims to protect its win conditions, such as Gurmag Angler, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with a mix of control elements.

The main focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to ramp up early game mana using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf, allowing for faster deployment of big threats like Boarding Party and Annoyed Altisaur. Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst help disrupt opponent's mana base while Skred provides removal. The deck aims to be aggressive and efficient, overwhelming opponents with powerful creatures like Avenging Hunter and Jewel Thief. Wild Growth and Llanowar Visionary provide additional ramp and card advantage to keep the pressure on the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by removing opponents' threats through removal spells and bouncing their permanents back to their hand. The deck also includes card draw and recursion to maintain card advantage. Additionally, there are some artifact synergies with the ability to sacrifice artifacts for additional value. The mana base consists of a mix of basic lands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana production. Overall, the strategy is to outvalue the opponent and control the game until victory is achieved.
